sovereign_country.strategic_role: 苏伊士运河经济特区、辐射中东及北非的低成本轻工制造

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Maritime Seafarer Staffing and Vessel Crew Management Agency

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 4 of 2024 (replacing Law No. 159 of 1981), Articles 1-40 (formation, corporate governance, capital rules for LLC), read with Investment Law No. 72 of 2017; sector-specific foundation: Maritime Trade Law No. 8 of 1990 (Articles 1-45) and Labor Law No. 12 of 2003 (Articles 28-32) for private employment agency licensing
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - One-Stop Shop / Tasis Portal, Cairo; Commercial Registry (Al-Sejel Al-Togary) under the Ministry of Trade and Industry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Incorporation Application and Articles of Association (Aqd Al-Taasis) filed through the GAFI Investor Portal, with signature authentication before the Notary Public (Shahr Al-Aqari)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for LLC; founders determine subscribed capital commensurate with the crew recruitment activity. No mandatory escrow account; cash contributions are deposited in a provisional corporate bank account supported by a bank certificate, while in-kind contributions require a licensed valuer's appraisal.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: First Board Resolution No. 1-2025 of [Company Name] LLC. The undersigned Board of Managers resolves: (1) ratification of the Articles of Association filed with GAFI and allocation of issued shares to the founders; (2) adoption of the registered office at [address], Cairo Governorate, Egypt; (3) appointment of [General Manager], [Chief Financial Officer] and [AML/Compliance Officer], each with banking mandate authority; (4) authorization for the General Manager to apply for the Egyptian Authority for Maritime Safety crew recruitment license, Ministry of Manpower private employment license, MLC 2006 compliance and STCW certificate verification; (5) approval of the corporate seal, bank account opening at [Bank], and publication of incorporation; (6) ratification of all pre-incorporation contracts signed for office lease and operational readiness.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and Commercial Scope Screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop / Tasis Portal (Investor Services Center)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File an application for name reservation via the GAFI online portal, submitting the proposed Arabic and English company names, with two alternates, and an activity description using ISIC 5222 / NAICS 488390. The officer verifies the absence of identical or deceptive registered marks and reserves the name.
required_dossiers: Three proposed company names
Copy of founder(s) national ID or passport
Signed nominee authorization if incorporating through an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If name is rejected, re-submit with alternative names; if refusal is contested, appeal to the GAFI Name Screening Committee within 30 calendar days of notification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Articles of Association (Aqd Al-Taasis) in Arabic reflecting the LLC structure, capital, management board, and crew recruitment purpose. All founders must appear before the notary in person or through duly notarized power of attorney to authenticate signatures; register the lease contract address and any in-kind contribution valuation.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Association pre-approved via GAFI portal
Valid national ID or passport of each founder
Provisional office lease contract (least 5 years or as required)
Appraisal report of any in-kind contribution
Power of attorney if founder is represented
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary queries, correct errors, pay re-authentication fees, re-attend; for foreign signatories, apostille/attestation documents through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and re-file within 10 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI Incorporation Application and Issuance of Incorporation Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete incorporation file electronically and physically to the GAFI one-stop window: including the notarized AOA, signed founders' declarations, corporate bank provisional deposit certificate, and payment of official fees. GAFI reviews the corporate objective for compatibility with the Maritime Trade Law and issues the GAFI Incorporation Certificate (Shahadat Al-Qayd).
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Association
Office lease contract duly authenticated
Bank certificate of provisional capital deposit
Criminal record certificate of each founder
Founders' residency verification documents
GAFI fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to GAFI comments within 15 days, amend the AOA and re-submit without additional filing fee; any rejection may be appealed to the GAFI Complaint Committee within 60 days of the refusal letter.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry, Tax, and Social Insurance Onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registry Office (Ministry of Trade) and Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) via GAFI integrated window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Use the GAFI commercial registration certificate to file entry in the Commercial Registry, obtain the Commercial Register Card, automatic tax card issuance, electronic invoice enrollment, and National Social Insurance number registration for founders and officers.
required_dossiers: GAFI incorporation certificate and company extract
Notarized Articles of Association
Manager and officer national IDs
Lease contract and proof of premises
Form 1 and Form 2 of the Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify any data mismatch between registry, tax, and NIS records; file amendment forms with supporting notarized documents; late registration penalties may be waived by written request to ETA within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Official Gazette Publication, Corporate Seal, and Bank Account Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Official Gazette (Al-Waqa'i Al-Masriya) and licensed corporate bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Publish the incorporation extract in the Official Gazette, obtain the corporate seal from an authorized engraver, and open the company's operational bank account at a licensed Egyptian bank with the first Board Resolution and banking mandate specifying authorized signatories for multi-currency payroll and wire transfers.
required_dossiers: Commercial registry certificate extract
GAFI incorporation certificate
First Board Resolution and banking mandate
Passport copies of authorized signatories
Company registration tax card
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests enhanced due diligence, provide source-of-funds declarations; if the Gazette publication is delayed, obtain a late fee assessment and re-file with an official request for acceleration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Sector Licensing and Operational Clearance for Crew Recruitment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Authority for Maritime Safety (EAMS) - Ministry of Transport; Ministry of Manpower (Competent Manpower Department)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the crew recruitment and manning agency license application to EAMS, demonstrating office premises, qualified maritime operations manager, insurance coverage, STCW compliance mechanisms, and MLC 2006 alignment; simultaneously file for the private employment agency license from the Ministry of Manpower under Labor Law No. 12 of 2003.
required_dossiers: Company incorporation certificate and commercial register card
Office lease and civil defense approval
Curriculum vitae and maritime credentials of the operations manager
Professional indemnity insurance policy
Declaration of STCW compliance procedures
List of cooperating shipowners and manning contracts template
Ministry of Manpower application form with fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Address technical deficiency letters from EAMS within 30 days through amended procedures; if manpower license is refused, appeal to the Permanent Dispute Resolution Committee of the Ministry of Manpower within 60 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Egyptian Authority for Maritime Safety (EAMS), Ministry of Transport, jointly with the Ministry of Manpower's Licensing Administration and the Civil Defense Directorate of the Ministry of Interior
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Crew Recruitment and Manning Agency Operating License (Rokhsat Tashghil Wela'at Al-Bahareen) under Maritime Trade Law No. 8 of 1990 and Labor Law No. 12 of 2003

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA), under Environment Law No. 4 of 1994 as amended by Law No. 9 of 2009
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B - Environmental Registration and Site Inspection (office-based crew agency; no full EIA report required, only a facility registration and simple operational environmental commitment letter)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Sanitary wastewater to municipal sewer network conforming to Ministerial Decree No. 44/2000 (BOD 350 mg/L, COD 700 mg/L); no VOC point sources for manning office operations; office e-waste must be handed to licensed recyclers under Waste Management Law No. 202/2020; ambient noise must not exceed 55 dB(A) daytime and 45 dB(A) nighttime per Decree No. 1095 of 2011.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense Directorate fire safety and site inspection certificate for office premises including emergency exit, portable extinguishers, and alarm verification; structural load clearance from a licensed engineer for leased space; workplace health and safety clearance from the Ministry of Manpower; registration of company safety plan with the relevant Labor Office before staff deployment commences.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) acting as the monetary, foreign-exchange and banking regulator under the Central Banking and Financial System Law No. 194 of 2020, Banking Law No. 88 of 2003, the 2024 unified floating exchange-rate policy decrees, and CBE-issued prudential regulations on current-account and capital-account transactions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt has accepted current-account convertibility obligations under IMF Article VIII, and the March 2024 CBE decision unified the EGP exchange rate, removed managed black-market intervention at commercial banks, and effectively moved the currency to a liberalized managed-float regime. Current-account transactions—crew recruitment fees, seafarer wage remittances, ship-management service payments, and subagent commissions—may be exchanged and remitted through authorized banks at market-determined rates, subject to full transaction documentation, source-of-funds verification, tax compliance clearance and bank-specific AML/KYC release procedures. Capital-account transactions remain subject to structural documentary controls: inbound foreign direct investment for share capital subscription must be routed through an authorized Egyptian bank, registered against the LLC's GAFI file and commercial register, and evidenced by a CBE-compliant inward transfer or investment certificate for future capital and dividend repatriation. Profit remittance hurdles are primarily practical and procedural: the paying bank will require audited Egyptian financial statements, Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) tax clearance or withholding-tax receipts, shareholders' meeting minutes approving the dividend, the original inward investment certificate matching the inbound capital transfer, a board resolution confirming distributable reserves, and completion of sanctions/source-of-funds screening. Banks may also queue large USD/EGP outbound transfers during liquidity tightness, and may condition remittance on confirmation that corporate tax, payroll taxes, social insurance and customs obligations have been settled.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Law No. 194 of 2020 and CBE application instructions, a maritime crew recruitment and ship-crew management agency exporting services must cause the full invoice value to be received into its Egyptian bank account through authorized banking channels within the prescribed settlement period; for crewing and seafarer payroll services the CBE-applied rule is generally repatriation within 90 days from invoice date or completion of the underlying crewing service, while goods-related maritime disbursements are subject to the six-month export-proceeds window. There is currently no mandatory fixed-percentage conversion of export proceeds into EGP after the 2024 float; the agency must nevertheless demonstrate that received foreign currency is either sold to the Egyptian banking system to settle domestic EGP obligations or retained in a CBE-approved foreign-currency account supported by a documented treasury rationale. The exporting LLC must submit to its relationship bank the underlying crew-management agreements, monthly payroll consolidations, CBE export documentation/return filings, and matching SWIFT MT103 records. The CBE may restrict future FX purchase allocations, impose reporting penalties, or require retrospective conversion if export receipts are unreported, delayed, under-invoiced, or not reconciled with commercial substance.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account (EGP + USD/EUR/GBP Multi-Currency)
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account (EGP + USD/EUR/GBP Multi-Currency)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Commercial International Bank of Egypt S.A.E. (CIB)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (EGP + USD/EUR/GBP Multi-Currency) with dedicated remittance/payroll module
Operational Account (EGP + USD/EUR/GBP) and ancillary trade/payroll product suite

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low for primary custodial treasury usage. Offshore digital EMI providers such as Wise, Revolut Business, Payoneer, Airwallex and Mena-based open-banking platforms are not licensed by the CBE to operate deposit-taking or settlement accounts for Egyptian corporate entities and cannot satisfy any capital-control, export-receipt or profit-repatriation obligation. They may be used only as a secondary convenience for immaterial seafarer training, courier or travel-card expenses, provided no operating revenue is diverted to them and all final beneficiary cash flows are consolidated back into the CBE-licensed Egyptian bank account. Any direct use of an unlicensed EMI for operating revenue would violate Law No. 194 of 2020, expose the LLC to AML penalties, and trigger automatic downgrade of the banking relationship risk rating.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory. CBE AML/CFT rules require the LLC's general manager, the designated finance/comptroller officer, and at least one direct or ultimate beneficial owner—for a non-resident-controlled Egyptian LLC, the 100%-shareholding ultimate beneficial owner—to attend the bank's corporate KYC interview, either at the branch in Egypt or at the bank's approved remote video-notarization site within Egypt. Remote-only account opening is generally unavailable for non-resident-controlled Egyptian LLCs because the bank must physically verify original commercial registry excerpts, GAFI certificates, board resolutions, national ID/passport specimens and specimen signatures. The compliance officer will also conduct a physical inspection of the registered office where the crew-recruitment center lacks established Egyptian trade references.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Undisclosed indirect shareholder or nominee-ownership structure masking the true beneficial owner of a foreign-controlled crew agency.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized/legalized beneficial-ownership declaration; full GAFI soft and hard registry extracts; chronological commercial-registry chain; unredacted passport/ID and certified residency proof for each direct and ultimate owner; source-of-wealth report prepared by a licensed Egyptian AML advisor; and two bank references covering the prior 24 months of the shareholder's banking history.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value inbound capital injection from an offshore holding company during the pre-revenue stage, lacking commercial substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shareholders' meeting minutes approving the capital increase or subscription; bank financing letter; audited or notarially certified parent-company financial statements; provenance-of-funds chain (dividend resolution, asset-sale contract, brokerage statement, trust deed); CBE purpose-code mapping to 'FDI in Egypt – share capital subscription'; detailed business plan; 13-week cash-flow forecast for the ship-crew recruitment book; and a signed undertaking that no funds originate from crypto, cash, unlicensed EMI wallets or opaque trusts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payroll disbursements to crews whose nationalities, passport specimens or vessel flag registries trigger OFAC, UN, EU or CBE sanctions-list hits.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Positive-name screening report against CBE-UN-OFAC-EU consolidated lists; seafarer discharge book and travel-document copies for each payee; STCW certificates; full payroll run with gross-to-net earnings breakdown and no third-party designee for the seafarer's salary; vessel IMO number and vessel commercial registry extract; shipowner and ship-manager KYC files; documented screening decision log with 'no match' conclusions; and director attestation that the agency does not serve sanctioned vessels or crew.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transaction-structuring red flags: frequent round-dollar amounts, multiple salary remittances below local reporting thresholds, or split payments to multiple seafarers on the same vessel within the same settlement window.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board-approved treasury policy setting per-transaction, per-day and per-quarter limits; consolidated payroll register with crew ID, bank account, employment contract reference and vessel assignment; signed ship-management agreement with full crewing schedule; one-file-per-vessel SWIFT MT103 payroll evidence showing no cash payments, no netting, and no receivable financing; audited annual financial statements; and VAT and social-insurance declaration receipts matching payroll volumes.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP involvement or government-linked vessel ownership, procurement officials or maritime labour leaders presenting a layered source of funds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed PEP and ownership declaration refreshed annually; source-of-funds and source-of-wealth profile for PEP-related balances; list of government-owned or state-linked flag vessels with official registry extracts; internal AML risk decision memorandum confirming no account operation is executed for the PEP personally; negative adverse-media screen reports; and sanctions-palette screening records for all political offices held.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All foreign shareholder capital must arrive as a clean SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's own bank through an authorized Egyptian bank. The wire must identify the Egyptian LLC, the IBC/beneficiary account number, and a CBE-compatible purpose code for 'FDI – equity participation in Egyptian LLC'; it must not be sent through unlicensed intermediaries, virtual account agents, or global EMI wallets. The receiving bank will screen the sender, verify the GAFI registry entry and shareholders' resolution, release the AML/KYC hold, execute the foreign-currency-to-EGP conversion at the day's unified market rate, and issue an official inward remittance/investment certificate. This certificate and the related conversion ticket are the threshold evidence for future dividend and capital repatriation and must be retained for the full CBE record-keeping period (generally five years).
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For crew wages, ship-management fees, subagent commissions and welfare-fund payments, the LLC will clear through (i) SWIFT MT103 payment orders for single-beneficiary seafarer salaries and low- or medium-value subagent remittances, (ii) SWIFT MT103/MT202 paired transfers for high-volume consolidated payroll runs, and (iii) confirmed irrevocable Commercial Letters of Credit only where a vessel owner requires documentary protection for a cumulative disbursement package; ordinary crew payroll does not require Letters of Credit. Domestic EGP disbursements to Egyptian suppliers, social-insurance authorities, the ETA and GAFI must be settled through the CBE real-time gross settlement system, and each foreign-currency disbursement must be supported by the underlying contract, commercial invoice, payroll schedule and withholding-tax certificate. Crew payroll in USD/EUR/GBP should be structured as mirrored individual MT103 messages from the multi-currency account rather than aggregated transfers, to preserve AML-transparent audit trails and avoid triggering fragmentation suspicious-activity alerts.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable USD/EGP forward contracts written by CBE-licensed bank market desks, available for tenors generally up to 12 months, requiring verified underlying receivables such as crew-fee invoices and manning contracts, plus a board-approved corporate hedging mandate.

FX swap agreements (USD/EGP, EUR/EGP, GBP/EGP) for intra-month liquidity bridging between scheduled crew payroll outflows and incoming invoice collections, executable with the relationship bank's FX market desk.

Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) for longer-term USD or EUR liabilities arising from CBE-registered parent-company loans or vessel-payroll funding structures, subject to CBE notification/approval thresholds and bank counterparty credit lines.

CBE-approved commercial-bank FX options (calls or puts on EGP) where warranted for concentrated bid or revenue exposure from a single shipowner; products are reviewed on a case-by-case basis and are not standard open-market instruments.

CBE-compliant Islamic hedging structures, including wa'ad-based unilateral promises converted into spot transactions, for sharia-sensitive shareholders and counterparties, provided the bank's Shariah committee approves the underlying exposure and the CBE product registration is in place.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Annual Return (Law 91/2005) with audited financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after fiscal year-end (by 30 April for calendar-year filers)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly late-payment interest of 2% on unpaid tax; administrative fines up to EGP 50,000 for non-filing; enforcement through asset attachment; no automatic strike-off, but ETA may suspend tax-license services needed for crew-licensing renewal.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited financial statements and directors' report filed in GAFI Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Commercial Registration office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than six months after fiscal-year end (by 30 June for calendar-year entities)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Persistent non-filing may attract GAFI administrative fines, suspension of commercial registration, and judicial strike-off after two consecutive years of non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO declaration and corporate register confirmation (final beneficial owner form)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI Beneficial Owner Register / Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually as part of Commercial Registry renewal; within 30 days after any 25%-or-more shareholding transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines under AML Law 80/2002 and its Executive Regulations; block of registry services and potential criminal penalty against responsible officers for incomplete declarations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of Ship Crew Recruitment Agency (manning office) operating license
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Maritime Transport Authority (EMTA), Ministry of Transport
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually at the anniversary of license issuance; application supported by valid commercial registry extract and NOSI clearance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unlicensed manning operations are subject to administrative closure, license revocation, and monetary fines under Egyptian Maritime Commercial Law No. 8/1990; continued operation can also render future license applications blocked.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual employer payroll and social insurance wage declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Consolidated annual insured-wages list submitted by 31 January after the calendar year; monthly wage schedules due by the 15th day of the following month
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late contribution payment attracts 2% monthly surcharge; unreported seafarer wages may result in economic-benefit assessment and criminal penalties for employer representatives.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Final monthly VAT return covering December (and annual VAT summary)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By last day of the month following each VAT period; December return serves as annual closing return due by 31 January
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file is penalized at the minimum 2% per month of the VAT due plus fixed non-filing fines specified in VAT Law 67/2016; no strike-off, but e-invoice access can be suspended.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under Law 159/1981, every Egyptian LLC must appoint a certified auditor and present audited annual financial statements; there is no revenue or asset-based exemption, including for the maritime crew-agency activity.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), issued by the Egyptian Ministry of Finance and closely converged with IFRS; filings with GAFI and ETA must be stated in EGP and prepared under EAS.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Pursuant to AML Law 80/2002 (as amended by Law 181/2022), the LLC must disclose direct and indirect final beneficial owners to GAFI and re-confirm the register annually at commercial registration renewal. A share/LLC quota transfer of 25% or more, or that otherwise changes control, must be recorded in the Commercial Registry and mirrored in the UBO register within 30 days; the prompt confirmation is a precondition for the new member to exercise quota rights.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book (shareholder resolutions and board meetings)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 750–1,800 USD per year for a Cairo registered office and licensed agent; 25–30% higher inside the Suez Canal Economic Zone for access to investment services.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 1,500–3,500 USD per statutory audit for a non-listed LLC with international crew payroll and multiple currencies.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard CIT rate 22.5% for LLCs; SME Law No. 152 of 2020 provides progressive preferential rates of 0.5% to 15% for companies with annual turnover not exceeding EGP 20 million; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 may grant up to 50% investment-cost deduction for licensed strategic activities; no standalone tax holiday for maritime crew-manning agencies.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual CIT return Form No. 19 (Tax Return for Legal Persons) with attached Transfer Pricing Disclosure Form; e-filed through the Egypt Tax Authority (ETA) online portal at eta.gov.eg.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; quarterly advance CIT installments; monthly payroll and WHT remittances.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual return due within four months after the end of the taxable fiscal year (e.g., 30 April for a 31 December year-end); quarterly advance payments due by the last day of the 4th, 6th, 9th, and 12th months after the start of the taxable period; final balance payable with the annual return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Commercial Registration Number (CRIC) and Tax Card Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the Egyptian LLC's unified tax ID; non-resident branch taxpayers must cite the PE registration and its commercial registry partition, annexing the foreign parent's incorporation certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal period covered (from date to date)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Show the annual period of the Egyptian PE's operation; non-calendar-year periods must match the parent's audited financial year where prior approval was obtained.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from activity (crew management fees, payroll-supply fees, seafarer placement commissions)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include only Egypt-source services attributable to the PE; re-invoiced manning services provided to non-resident shipowners must be reported gross with an arm's-length markup.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of services and direct operating expenses (seafarer wages borne by the agency, marine insurance, vessel-support expenditure)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deduct only contractually supported and bank-transferred costs; crew wages recharged to foreign principals are pass-through items and must not be expensed unless legally owed by the agency.
Head-office cost allocations require documented cost-sharing and a transfer-pricing analysis; home-office general expenses are deductible only with invoice support and of the Egyptian PE's benefit.
Apply Egyptian statutory depreciation percentages from the Executive Regulations; assets imported from related parties use arm's-length CIF value.
Deduction is capped by the 4:1 debt-to-equity thin-capitalization rule for non-resident shareholder loans; the excess is non-deductible and cannot be carried forward.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable profit before loss offset (accounting profit reconciliation)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile accounting profit to taxable profit; any advance pricing agreement covering the maritime staffing service must be annexed.
Loss carryforward is limited to five years; PE losses attributable to the foreign head office are not deductible against the Egyptian PE's income.
Report all cross-border controlled transactions, including manning services to foreign shipowners and management fees paid to affiliates; select and state the TP method.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Withholding tax credits and advance payments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Credit WHT suffered on bank certifications; non-resident PEs may offset Egyptian WHT only where supported by treaty and Tax Residency Certificate (TRC).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: fine of up to EGP 100,000 with escalation to criminal proceedings; late payment: surcharge of 1% per month or part-month on the unpaid CIT; understatement or evasion: additional penalty of up to 100% of the avoided tax plus director liability.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 41a (quarterly non-resident payment WHT return covering dividends, interest, and royalties) and monthly PAYE return Form 1a for crew payroll; both e-filed on the ETA portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly (payroll/PAYE) and quarterly (withholding tax on payments to non-residents and distributed profits).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: PAYE and WHT remitted to the ETA by the 15th day of the month following the payment month; quarterly WHT summary return due by the last day of the month immediately following the quarter.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the non-resident shareholder, lender, or licensor's full legal name, country of residence, and TRC reference for treaty claims.
State gross remittance in EGP using the ETA exchange rate; do not reduce the base by bank transfer fees or intermediary charges.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable WHT rate and treaty basis
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Default statutory rates: 10% dividends, 20% interest/royalties; treaty reduction applies only with the payer's beneficial-ownership declaration and a valid TRC.
Use the ETA-generated payment slip reference and attach the SWIFT/bank receipt; the non-resident must retain the WHT certificate for foreign tax credit claims at home.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late remittance: 1% monthly delay surcharge; intentional non-withholding: the payer is jointly liable for the unpaid WHT, a criminal fine of up to EGP 100,000, and possible prosecution of the finance director.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding tax on profit distributions made by an Egyptian LLC to its shareholders, including non-resident investors, under Article 55 of Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: A non-resident shareholder seeking a reduced or zero treaty rate must (i) obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the treaty-state revenue authority, (ii) submit the TRC and a claim form to the Egyptian paying LLC before distribution, and (iii) instruct the payer to attach a beneficial-ownership declaration to its quarterly WHT return; the ETA may require online TRC verification and, for corporate shareholders, proof of substantive business activity and minimum holding period to access the participation exemption; refund of excess WHT may be claimed through the ETA within two years.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT of 20% on interest and royalties paid to non-residents without an Egyptian PE; treaty rates commonly 10-15% for both categories where a certified TRC and beneficial-ownership declaration are filed; management and consultancy fees paid to foreign affiliates remain at the 20% statutory rate absent treaty relief.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File mandatory where the aggregate annual value of cross-border controlled transactions exceeds EGP 8 million; Master File mandatory where aggregate controlled transactions exceed EGP 20 million or the multinational group's consolidated global revenue exceeds EGP 1 billion; the Transfer Pricing Disclosure Form is mandatory for all taxpayers with related-party transactions regardless of threshold.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt does not operate an explicit Economic Substance Regulation framework comparable to Gulf Cooperation Council states; however, the general anti-avoidance rules in Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005, the substance-over-form doctrine, and beneficial-ownership requirements mandate that a crew-manning agency maintain local office premises, operational staff, board decision-making, and real commercial risk; a shell subsidiary engaged solely in intercompany invoicing of manning fees will be disregarded, with profit reallocation and penalties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsifying books, understating maritime payroll income, fabricating seafarer employment contracts, or deliberately omitting manning fees received from foreign principals.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment of 3 to 5 years and a fine of EGP 10,000 to EGP 100,000; full assessment of evaded tax plus an additional penalty of up to 100% of the avoided amount and a 1% monthly monetary surcharge.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed false returns or directed concealed revenue are jointly and severally liable; civil restitution of the tax deficit, criminal imprisonment, disqualification from board service, and a ministerial travel ban where unpaid tax exceeds EGP 500,000.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Letterbox LLC without local premises or operational staff, whose sole function is routing crew supply fees to a non-resident related party through back-to-back contracts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Disregard of the shell structure under GAAR, reallocation of the entire profit to the Egyptian shareholder or PE, disallowance of all intercompany deductions, and a 200% penalty on unreported income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Veil piercing for abuse of legal personality; directors personally liable for the shortfall, subject to travel bans, asset attachment, and criminal prosecution for fraudulent use of the corporate vehicle.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare Local File or Master File when thresholds are exceeded; omitting the Transfer Pricing Disclosure Form from the annual CIT return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fixed penalty of EGP 50,000 up to EGP 10,000,000 for documentation non-compliance; forced arm's-length adjustment with a 30% penalty on the adjusted amount; 1% monthly deferred-payment surcharge.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The signatory director is exposed to fines and imprisonment for missing contemporaneous TP records; tax advisors who certified incomplete files face professional liability and license sanctions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Misclassifying Egyptian or foreign seafarers as independent contractors to avoid PAYE and social insurance; paying crew wages through unregistered foreign payroll accounts; failing to remit withheld taxes on ship-crew salaries.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: 1% monthly surcharge on unremitted payroll WHT; fixed penalties per under-declared seafarer for social insurance; disallowance of the salary expense; criminal prosecution for repeated non-compliance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for unremitted employee WHT and social contributions; travel ban and asset attachment arise when payroll liabilities exceed EGP 100,000; confiscation of withheld sums is treated as embezzlement.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Absence of customer due diligence on foreign shipowners, failure to identify beneficial owners of vessel operators, processing suspicious seafarer payroll flows, and executing SWIFT transfers to sanctioned entities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under AML Law No. 80 of 2002: fines of up to EGP 10 million and imprisonment of 2 to 7 years; account freezing; revocation of the crewing agency license by the Ministry of Transport.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Criminal liability and imprisonment apply to beneficial owners and directors who ignore AML obligations; license revocation dismantles the corporate structure and exposes directors to civil restitution claims from seafarers and principals.
